query: INSERT INTO runtime_outbox_health (singleton, owner_active, claimed_rows, checked_at, last_progress_at) VALUES (true, true, 0, clock_timestamp(), CASE WHEN $1 THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE NULL END) ON CONFLICT (singleton) DO UPDATE SET owner_active = true, claimed_rows = 0, checked_at = EXCLUDED.checked_at, last_progress_at = CASE WHEN $1 THEN GREATEST(runtime_outbox_health.last_progress_at, EXCLUDED.last_progress_at) ELSE runtime_outbox_health.last_progress_at END
